before.description: WP Login/Admin Challenge (all subdomains except wpcontrol)
before.expression: (ends_with(http.host, ".mrndev.io") and http.host ne "wpcontrol.mrndev.io" and ((http.request.method eq "POST" and (http.request.uri.path eq "/wp-login.php" or http.request.uri.path eq "/site-login" or http.request.uri.path eq "/site-login.php")) or (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/wp-admin/") and http.request.uri.path ne "/wp-admin/admin-ajax.php" and http.request.method in {"POST" "PUT" "PATCH" "DELETE"})))

after.description: WP Login/Admin Challenge (all subdomains except wpcontrol)
after.expression: ((ends_with(http.host, ".mrndev.io") and http.host ne "wpcontrol.mrndev.io" and ((http.request.method eq "POST" and (http.request.uri.path eq "/wp-login.php" or http.request.uri.path eq "/site-login" or http.request.uri.path eq "/site-login.php")) or (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/wp-admin/") and http.request.uri.path ne "/wp-admin/admin-ajax.php" and http.request.method in {"POST" "PUT" "PATCH" "DELETE"}))) and not (http.host eq "admin-editor-pilot.mrndev.io" and http.request.uri.path eq "/wp-admin/post.php" and http.request.method eq "POST" and http.cookie contains "wordpress_logged_in_"))

scope: Only the exact review host native post.php POST with a WordPress logged-in cookie is excluded from this custom managed challenge. Basic Auth, WordPress cookie/nonce/capability validation, managed WAF and all other hosts/routes remain enforced. Cookie presence at the edge is not authentication.
